title: General Statutes of Connecticut, Title 31 (Labor), Chapter 558 — Wages
verified_how: fetched the register chapter page: heading 'CHAPTER 558 WAGES', section list running from Sec. 31-58 (Definitions) through the 31-76 series; page carries the standard currency note 'Readers should refer to the 2026 Supplement, revised to January 1, 2026'. Chapter also listed as live in the Title 31 index.
notes: Covers minimum wage (§§ 31-58, 31-60), overtime, wage payment and deductions (§ 31-71a et seq.) and payment of final wages on separation (§ 31-71c).
